verdict.rationale: Vercel's preview environments automatically spin up an isolated deployment for every git push/branch, enabling parallel work by any team member without conflict, and environment/variable management supports local, preview, production, and custom environments concurrently. This directly matches the story of unlimited isolated environments for simultaneous shipping. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of 'unlimited' concurrency limits/pricing tiers and independent hands-on validation of scale under heavy team usage.
